scope: Independent installed Playwright and original native adapter audit; historical development measurements remain retained

installed_code_findings.observation: Default connect-over-CDP selects acceptDownloads=accept and sends allowAndName download behavior using a temporary adapter artifact directory.
The default connection also enables focus emulation; noDefaults for the browser default context skips this override.
The default connection invokes media-emulation updates; noDefaults skips that initialization. No retrospective claim is made about the exact effective OS/media values in each old frame.

historical_scope: Prior frames remain actual owned HWND pixel captures of their measured assets and physical DPI. Their CDP-driven interactions and media/focus environment were instrumented; they do not establish untouched physical Windows focus or normal native download behavior. Original per-case grades and raw events remain unchanged.
final_measurement_requirement: Final once-only native execution and visual scoring must use the frozen no_defaults=True connector and final source/assets. Historical development scores are not promoted to final scores.
